nodes.title: HOW TO USE
widgets_values:
ONE WORKFLOW FOR ALL VIDEO  (MiniMax H3, with sound)

1. WHAT DO YOU WANT: pick the mode.
2. Paste what that mode needs (click a box, Ctrl+V or drag a file):
   1 Animate        PICTURE A
   2 Text only      nothing
   3 Motion/swap    PICTURE A (new character) + VIDEO (the moves). The
                    character is fully redrawn; DESCRIBE sets the place.
   4 New background VIDEO + PICTURE B (the new place; it gets gently
                    animated, the video's character is cut out and put on top)
   5 New camera     VIDEO + set the CAMERA box (same action re-filmed)
   New character on a picture background = run 3, then put its result
   in VIDEO and run 4.
   Unused boxes are ignored - leave whatever is in them.
3. DESCRIBE: what happens + the SOUND. Mode 1-2 need a full
   description; modes 3-5 already know what to do, add details
   ("night time", "rainy", "he laughs at the end").
4. SIZE + DURATION, then Run.  Result: ComfyUI\output\video\ALL_IN_ONE

SIZE: shape + megapixels (0.4 = fast test, 0.98 = 768p). For video modes
  pick the SAME SHAPE as your video (16:9 / 9:16 ...).
DURATION: seconds (2-5 practical on this PC). Video modes use the part of
  the VIDEO from START (s) for that long. Reference videos work best at 24 fps.
LOOP? (mode 1): ends on PICTURE A again = seamless idle loop.
USE PICTURE B AS EXTRA REFERENCE? (modes 3, 5): name it <Picture 2>
  in DESCRIBE.
KEEP VIDEO'S SOUND? (mode 5): uses the video's audio as reference.
Mode 4 DESCRIBE = the ambient motion + sound of the new place
  ("flags flutter, people stroll far behind. Audio: market chatter").
SEED: 'fixed' repeats a take (e.g. re-run it bigger), 'randomize' = new.
Speed: ~70-90 s for 3-4 s at 0.4 MP. Mode 5 ~3-4 min (redraws 4 keyframes first).
Switching between modes 1,2,4 and 3,5 loads a different 20 GB model (+1 min).

nodes.title: USE PICTURE B AS EXTRA REFERENCE? (modes 3, 5)
3. DESCRIBE  (what happens + the sound)
widgets_values:
3D cartoon animation, plain off-white studio background, camera locked off in a full-body shot. He does a happy little dance and waves at the camera.
Audio: upbeat cheerful music.

nodes.title: LOOP? (mode 1: end on PICTURE A again)

widgets_values: The character from <Picture 1> performs exactly the same body motion as the pose video, with the same timing. Keep the design, colours and proportions of the character in <Picture 1> exactly.

widgets_values_named.string_a: The character from <Picture 1> performs exactly the same body motion as the pose video, with the same timing. Keep the design, colours and proportions of the character in <Picture 1> exactly.

widgets_values: The camera is completely still, locked off, no cuts. Only gentle ambient motion in this place, nothing new enters the foreground.

widgets_values_named.string_a: The camera is completely still, locked off, no cuts. Only gentle ambient motion in this place, nothing new enters the foreground.

widgets_values: Re-create the action of <Video 1> exactly - the same character, motion, timing, background and sound - but filmed from the new camera angle shown in <Picture 1>. The video starts on <Picture 1> and keeps that camera angle.
